content:
alex: Quick sync: preflight for quant-kernel v5.3 is showing an anomaly on matmul memory growth during the 60s stress run. Holding the full rollout. Need a short rollback/pin plan and a 1-liner for release notes.
priya: On it. What TTL are we comfortable with if we pin? this one's risky.
josh: Suggest pin TTL 2h, fallback engine-quant:v5.2. We can extend if smoke is clean. Keep slices small: 0.25,0.5,1.
mara: Agreed on slices. Also add a thermal region hold: skip ap-southeast-1 for first two slices.
deploy-bot: depbot: preflight smoke failed: test-suite matmul-memory-growth > baseline threshold (20% increase). /preflight rbus-174462 reported failure.
alex: Can we isolate perf-flag? v5.3 has quant-int4-accel=true by default. Can we toggle?
priya: Yes, we can. Plan: run slice 0.25 with quant-int4-accel=false to confirm if flag is culprit. If that's green, gradually enable.
josh: Rollout command: `/rollout create engine-quant:v5.3 --slices 0.25,0.5,1 --fallback engine-quant:v5.2 --pin-ttl 2h --ff quant-int4-accel=false`
deploy-bot: depbot: rollout queued (rbus-174462). Skipping regions: ap-southeast-1 for slices 0.25 and 0.5.
infra-bot: infra: note: cluster-c12 had a recent kernel patch applied yesterday; if we see host OOMs, we should quiesce that cluster.
priya: Rollback criteria draft: immediate abort if matmul mem-growth >15% sustained for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR any OOMs in canary pods. Also abort if p95 latency regresses >200ms over baseline for 5m.
mara: Add a safety TTL unpin: unpin command to remove stuck pin quickly: `/pin remove engine-quant:v5.3` and then `/rollout create engine-quant:v5.2 --slices 2,10 --pin-ttl 1h`
alex: Release note line: "Runtime: quant kernel v5.3 (int4 accel toggle) — fixes throughput for short prompts; staged canary; flag default OFF on first slices." Keep it short.
josh: Let's also add an ops checklist: preflight smoke green, no host-level OOMs for 10m, kv-cache hitrate stable +/-2%. If any check fails we abort.
deploy-bot: depbot: scheduled canary start 2024-11-04T01:15:00Z (rbus-174462). Preflight requires manual ack after triage.
oncall: Got it. We'll watch mem-growth, p95, and eviction counts. We'll post status every 3m during slice ramp.
priya: I'll run a quick memory flamegraph on the failing run and post findings here before canary.
mara: If we need to delay full rollout, prefer delaying to tomorrow morning rather than risk night operations.
alex: Agreement: delay full ramp if ambiguity remains after triage. For now go with the adjustable-flag canary plan. I'll update the release-bus blurb.
priya: posting triage notes: initial flamegraph indicates allocator hotspots in matmul path maybe due to packing change. Investigating patch revert feasibility.
josh: If revert is quick we can switch to v5.2 and rework patch. Else we proceed with flag-disabled rollout to gather stable telemetry.
alex: Thanks. Reconvene here after triage or at 01:10 UTC for final go/no-go.
